description.zh: 让 AI 感知你的输入时长和欲言又止，随用户消息注入Fingertips 显性附件。只记节奏，永不记内容。
description.en: Let AI sense typing duration and hesitation without reading or storing input content.

description.zh: 查看输入节奏状态、隐私配置并清理本地 Fingertips 记录。不会读取输入框原文。
description.en: View rhythm status and clear local records. Input text is never read.
